title: Upgrade /search empty state into a smart recovery flow (retain users when no workers found)

requirements.text: Replace the current static /search empty state UI in frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPage.tsx with a mobile-first “smart recovery” flow that always gives the user a clear next action instead of leaving them stuck.

quotes:
Improve "No workers found" page for user retention.

Goal:
Never leave user stuck.
Always give next action.

Replace static message with smart recovery flow.

acceptanceCriteria: When a search returns zero workers (after loading), the page renders a recovery UI instead of only the existing static empty-state content.
The recovery UI is optimized for mobile (simple layout, large tap targets, minimal text clutter).
The existing non-empty results UI (grouping, cards, sorting) remains unchanged.

requirements.text: In the /search empty state, display a friendly message using the exact Tamil text provided by the user, and source it via the existing i18n system (useI18n().t) so it can render as bilingual text (Tamil primary + English secondary) without hardcoded inline strings.

quotes:
1) Show friendly Tamil message:
"உங்கள் பகுதியில் வேலைக்காரர்கள் இன்னும் சேரவில்லை.
அருகிலுள்ள பகுதிகளில் தேடலாம் அல்லது வேலை பதிவு செய்யலாம்."

acceptanceCriteria: A new i18n key is added for this empty-state friendly message.

The Tamil (regional) value matches exactly:
"உங்கள் பகுதியில் வேலைக்காரர்கள் இன்னும் சேரவில்லை.
அருகிலுள்ள பகுதிகளில் தேடலாம் அல்லது வேலை பதிவு செய்யலாம்."
The message is rendered using the app’s bilingual rendering pattern (BilingualText or equivalent), not as a raw string.

requirements.text: In the /search empty state, automatically show a list of nearby approved workers when browser geolocation is available, without requiring additional user input.

quotes:
2) Auto show nearby area workers
Search nearby pincode radius automatically

acceptanceCriteria: If browser geolocation is granted and coordinates are available, the empty state renders a “nearby workers” section below the friendly message.
Nearby workers are fetched using the existing nearby-workers flow (do not add filter UI).
If geolocation is denied/unavailable, the nearby workers section is not shown and the rest of the recovery UI still works.
The nearby workers list renders safely when optional worker fields are missing (location, skills, phone, photo).

requirements.text: Add an “Expand Search Area” secondary action in the /search empty state that increases the nearby search radius and refreshes the nearby workers section accordingly (only when geolocation is available).

quotes:
Secondary: Expand Search Area
-> increase radius

acceptanceCriteria: A large, mobile-friendly secondary button labeled via i18n (“Expand Search Area”) is shown in the empty state.
Clicking the button increases the effective nearby distance threshold and updates the nearby list (e.g., shows more workers / workers from farther away) without a page reload.
If geolocation is unavailable, the button is either hidden or disabled with safe behavior (no errors).

requirements.text: In the /search empty state, show “related skill suggestions” based on the user’s current search (prefer q when present; otherwise category/subcategory/area context). Suggestions must be tap-friendly and start a new /search?q=<suggestion> search when tapped.

quotes:
3) Show related skill suggestions based on search
Example:
search: plumber
show: motor repair, borewell, pump repair, electrician

acceptanceCriteria: When there are no workers, a “related suggestions” section appears with a small list of tap-friendly suggestion chips/buttons.
Tapping a suggestion navigates to /search with search param { q: <suggestion> }.
Suggestions are derived from existing app data sources (e.g., live suggestions / taxonomy / skills) and are safe when inputs are empty.
No additional filter UI is added as part of this change.

requirements.text: Add two big action buttons to the /search empty state: (1) Primary: “Post a Work Request” which navigates to the existing job request page route (/post-job); (2) Secondary: “Expand Search Area” (covered separately) with large, mobile-friendly styling.

quotes:
4) Add 2 big action buttons:

Primary: Post a Work Request
-> user can submit job requirement
-> notify matching workers later

Secondary: Expand Search Area
-> increase radius

acceptanceCriteria: The empty state shows a prominent primary button labeled via i18n: “Post a Work Request”.
Clicking “Post a Work Request” navigates to the existing job post page at route /post-job.
Buttons are large and easy to tap on mobile (no tiny links).
This change does not add new backend notification features; it uses the existing job request submission flow.

requirements.text: Add a WhatsApp help CTA to the /search empty state, showing the exact Tamil prompt text provided by the user (sourced via i18n), and render a WhatsApp button that opens a WhatsApp chat/help link.

quotes:
5) Show WhatsApp help CTA:
"உங்களுக்கு உடனடி உதவி வேண்டுமா?"
WhatsApp button

acceptanceCriteria: The empty state displays the WhatsApp help prompt text via i18n, with Tamil matching exactly: "உங்களுக்கு உடனடி உதவி வேண்டுமா?"
A WhatsApp button is shown; clicking it opens a WhatsApp link (new tab or same tab is acceptable) and does not throw errors.
The WhatsApp CTA is visually simple and mobile-friendly.

requirements.text: Ensure that the empty state recovery UI never renders technical category/taxonomy codes (e.g., "homeimprovement", "specializedcleaning") anywhere in visible text; all category/subcategory/suggestion labels shown in the empty-state flow must be human-readable and should use the existing bilingual label helpers / i18n lookups with safe humanized fallbacks.

quotes:
6) Never show technical category codes like:
homeimprovement, specializedcleaning

Show only human readable Tamil labels.

acceptanceCriteria: No raw taxonomy slugs/codes are displayed in the empty state (including suggestion labels and any category chips).
Any label derived from stored strings is converted to a human-readable display label using existing helper utilities (and/or i18n mappings).
If a translation is missing, the UI uses a safe humanized label (not the raw key/slug).

requirements.text: Extend the local i18n translation dictionary (frontend/src/components/i18n/translations.ts) with keys needed for the new empty-state recovery flow (friendly message, section labels, button labels, WhatsApp prompt), and ensure they resolve through useI18n().t without showing raw keys.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: New i18n keys for the empty-state recovery flow exist with both English and Tamil values.
No new user-visible strings in the recovery flow are hardcoded as raw i18n keys (e.g., "search.empty.*" must never appear).
The Tamil values include the two exact user-provided Tamil sentences for the friendly message and WhatsApp prompt.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text in this build request document; UI may include Tamil as required by the app’s bilingual system.
Do not add any booking, payment, or in-app chat flows; keep direct-contact + job-request model unchanged.
Do not modify immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not display raw taxonomy slugs/codes (e.g., homeimprovement, specializedcleaning) in the new empty-state flow.
Keep the existing /search results rendering (sorting/grouping/cards) unchanged when results exist; only enhance the empty-state experience.
nonGoals: Do not implement real notifications to workers (“notify matching workers later”) beyond the existing job post submission capability.
Do not add new filter UI to /search as part of this change.
Do not change backend data schemas solely for this empty-state UX unless strictly required for nearby-worker retrieval (prefer reusing existing nearby worker APIs/hooks).
Do not redesign the entire Search Results page; scope is limited to the no-results recovery flow.
